generate_graph_edge_index: generate an edge index for a barabasi albert or watts strogatz graph with configurable sparsity and seed
create_talklinear_layer: create a TalkLinear layer where neurons communicate according to a relational graph structure with configurable message type
create_talkconv2d_layer: create a TalkConv2d layer that applies graph-structured weight masking to convolutional filters with configurable sparsity
build_symmetric_linear: build a SymLinear layer that enforces symmetric weight matrices by summing weight with its transpose
create_sparse_linear: create a SparseLinear layer that applies a boolean mask to zero out specified weight connections based on edge index
